agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Triapine inhibits an enzyme responsible for producing molecules required for the production of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), which may inhibit tumor cell growth.

coder_notes: Conditions also list grade 2 and 3 glioma, but eligibility requires an established diagnosis of recurrent glioblastoma (IDH-wildtype), so gbm_only. Temozolomide given in all arms, coded soc_backbone. Methemoglobin level and cfDNA fragmentomics are listed; neither is clearly a target-modulation measure, so target engagement unclear. G6PD screening is a germline safety marker and not recorded.
